meta.source: DAFMAN 36-2806, Military Awards: Criteria and Procedures, Attachment 5
meta.notes: Transcribed from Attachment 5 of AFMAN 36-2806 dated 10 June 2019, the last copy of the manual that could be read outside a .mil network. The current DAFMAN 36-2806 keeps the same paragraph numbers (the myDecs Reimagined template cites A5.2.7, A5.2.10 and A5.2.11 for the same three decorations, and A5.1.10 and A5.1.14 for numbers and abbreviations), but the wording has not been read against it, so this file stays a stub. The 2019 manual names the Air Force Commendation and Achievement Medals; the labels here use the Air and Space names the template uses. The Space Force closing ('United States Space Force') is an assumption, not a transcription. Short titles follow A5.1.6: spell out the full grade in the opening sentence, then use the short title. Chaplain titles (A5.1.6) are not handled.

rules.text: The inclusive period stays on one line.
"long and" in a retirement closing is for 30 or more years of service.

No abbreviations other than Jr., Sr., II, III after the name; spell out the grade in the opening sentence, then use the short title. Code names such as RED FLAG are fine. Never split the member's name across two lines.
Numeric unit designators read 3rd Aerospace Wing, 4th Mission Support Group.
Numbers through nine are spelled out unless space is limited.
Only abbreviations and acronyms on the approved DAF list.
